row.name: group_invitations_valid
row.value: octet_length("token_hash") = 32 and "expires_at" > "created_at" and ("email" is null) = ("normalized_email" is null) and ("email" is null or char_length("email") between 3 and 320) and ("state" <> 'open' or "email" is not null)

row.name: group_key_seals_valid
row.value: "group_key_version" >= 1 and "holder_key_version" >= 1 and "roster_version" >= 1 and octet_length("roster_digest") = 32 and octet_length("envelope") = 4597

row.name: group_key_successions_lengths_valid
row.value: octet_length("last_roster_digest") = 32 and octet_length("digest") = 32 and octet_length("new_ed25519_public_key") = 32 and octet_length("new_ml_dsa_public_key") = 1952 and octet_length("signer_ml_dsa_public_key") = 1952 and octet_length("statement") between 1 and 16384 and octet_length("ed25519_signature") = 64 and octet_length("ml_dsa_signature") = 3309 and octet_length("signer_signature") = 3373

row.name: group_memberships_timeline_valid
row.value: ("state" <> 'active' or "admitted_at" is not null) and (("state" in ('left', 'removed')) = ("left_at" is not null))

row.name: group_rosters_chain_valid
row.value: "version" >= 1 and "group_key_version" >= 1 and octet_length("digest") = 32 and ("version" = 1) = ("previous_digest" is null) and ("previous_digest" is null or octet_length("previous_digest") = 32)

row.name: group_rosters_statement_valid
row.value: octet_length("statement") between 1 and 4194304 and octet_length("signer_ml_dsa_public_key") = 1952 and octet_length("ed25519_signature") = 64 and octet_length("ml_dsa_signature") = 3309 and octet_length("signer_signature") = 3373

row.name: groups_head_valid
row.value: "roster_version" >= 1 and octet_length("roster_digest") = 32 and "group_key_version" >= 1 and "chain_revision" >= 1 and ("seat_limit" is null or "seat_limit" >= 1)

row.name: area_grants_valid
row.value: "workspace_key_version" >= 1 and "grantee_key_version" >= 1 and "roster_version" >= 1 and octet_length("roster_digest") = 32 and octet_length("envelope") = 4565
